worldcombat.skill.tickle.summary: Close in and tickle a foe to cut its Attack and Defence at once; it deals no damage itself. You must be at contact range, and the rough version drops more and makes the tickle last longer, but winds up and cools down much slower.
worldcombat.skill.tickle.use.1: Cut both Attack and Defence in a grapple
worldcombat.skill.tickle.use.2: Let an ally win the first exchange
worldcombat.skill.tickle.description.0: Tickling lowers Attack by %1$s stages and Defense by %2$s stages for %3$s. Both recover when the ticklish fit ends or is dispelled. Repeated tickling during the fit does not stack. Deals no damage.
worldcombat.skill.tickle.description.1: The reach is about %1$s blocks; from too far away the tickle whiffs and nothing happens.
worldcombat.skill.tickle.description.2: Reaching in takes %1$s with a %2$s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.tickle.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s, recovery %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.tickle.preference.firm: A light tickle has a faster windup and shorter cooldown. A rough tickle lowers Attack and Defence by one additional stage and leaves the mark longer, with a longer windup and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.tickle.preference.ai.m: The companion only considers closing in while a threat is within this many blocks; smaller keeps it in a grapple, larger starts the chase sooner.
worldcombat.skill.tickle.preference.ai.o: Countering reaches in only while the enemy attacks the companion or its owner, or right after a hit; Anytime tickles any adjacent threat.
worldcombat.skill.tickle.preference.ai.l: When on, the companion may leave its post to tickle under a Hold order.
